filing_office: Georgia Secretary of State, Corporations Division
filing_fee_notes: 100 filing fee plus mandatory 10 service charge, online or paper. Annual registration totals 60, comprising 50 plus 10; name reservation totals 35, comprising 25 plus 10.
registered_agent_rules: Continuously maintain an eligible agent at a Georgia street address where service can be received. A P.O. box or mail drop is insufficient; the LLC cannot be its own agent.
standard_processing_time: Generally about 7 business days online, 10-14 business days for uploaded paper filings, or 15 business days after receipt by mail; workload affects timing.
expedite_options: Additional 120 for two-business-day service or 275 for same-business-day service when submitted before noon. The mail-filing guide also lists one-hour service for an additional 1200.
annual_report_due: January 1 through April 1 each year, beginning the calendar year after formation.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a Georgia registered agent. File the annual registration beginning the following year.
common_mistake: Assuming a name reservation creates the LLC.
notes: Domestic LLC scope. Fees include the service charges shown in the current fee schedule. Franchise/privilege tax, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
